messages.author: 09e9d545e0510a59
messages.subject: scanone summary
parts:
Hello all,

I'm doing qtl analysis in a tomato riself population (ca. 3000 markers, 130 individuals). My sacnone plot for several traits suggest more than one qtl per chromosome in one or more chromosomes. See attached example for all chromosomes and zoom-in on chr 11. I'm trying to get summary of all peaks (that will include position and support interval), but scanone summaries take only the most significant qtl at a given chromosome.

So, my question is: Is there a way to get this data, rather than manually look at the output lods and plots?

In this specific example, while for chr 2 and 3, model-selection (using makeqtl, addqtl, fitqtl, refineqtl and swqtl) did a great job refining qtl position, it indicates only one qtl for chr 11. These three qtl on chr 11 are supported also from earlier works by others so I'm quite confidence about them.

Thanks,

Itay

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] scanone summary
parts:
There's not currently an automated way to pick out the multiple peaks on a chromosome in the output from scanone.

Karl
